slides.text: Something happened during a live demo of a tool I built, and I want to walk through the actual mechanics of what I did with the recording afterward.

citations.quote: Something happened during a live demo of a tool I built

slides.text: I asked the tool for a five-second video. Nothing came back. Not slow — nothing.

citations.quote: I asked the tool for a five-second video.

slides.text: A working demo proves the tool can work once, under conditions you controlled, with every rough edge removed before anyone saw it. A broken demo, left broken, proves something you can't fake.

citations.quote: A working demo proves the tool can work once, under conditions you controlled, with every rough edge removed before anyone saw it.
A broken demo, left broken, proves something you can't fake

slides.text: Anyone can have a bug. What you can't manufacture after the fact is an honest reaction to one, on camera, in real time.

citations.quote: What you can't manufacture after the fact is an honest reaction to one, on camera, in real time.

slides.text: I didn't cut the silence. I didn't re-order anything to make the timing look tighter than it was. I posted the take with the failure in it, in the order it happened.

citations.quote: I posted the take with the failure in it, in the order it happened

slides.text: The version with the mistake still in it is very often the more convincing one, not despite the mistake, but because of what you do with it.

citations.quote: The version with the mistake still in it is very often the more convincing one, not despite the mistake, but because of what you do with it.
